Reviewed and accepted the implementer's contract_change: diagnosisPatchSchema carries the stored calculator shape and refuses diarySource/diarySuggestion in a PATCH via superRefine (400). backupSchemas.ts unwraps .shape.calculator, so backups with diary marks restore. Verified by reading the code and by the green done-when run; no change made.

Frontend contract as built by this unit and confirmed in src/api/diagnosesApi.ts: applyDiarySuggestion(id) POSTs /api/diagnoses/:id/diary-suggestion with no body and returns the whole Diagnosis; 409 no_diary_suggestion when the draft has no suggestion, 409 diagnosis_not_draft once completed, 404 diagnosis_not_found. A PATCH that carries calculator.diarySource or calculator.diarySuggestion is refused with 400.
